_note: Genealogy edges (parent/child, spouse) live on each person's own record under `genealogy` and are not duplicated here. This file holds narrative relationship edges — types documented in CLAUDE.md: mentorship, collaboration, rivalry, conversion — added only where the story text of a full-tier entry documents them.

edges.note: Samuel anointed David as Saul's successor while David was still a shepherd boy, at God's direction.
Aaron served as Moses' spokesman before Pharaoh and co-led Israel through the Exodus, though he also built the golden calf in Moses' absence.
Jonathan and David formed a covenant friendship; Jonathan repeatedly protected David from Saul at his own risk and forfeited his claim to the throne.
Paul publicly opposed Peter at Antioch, calling him a hypocrite for withdrawing from table fellowship with Gentile believers under pressure from certain Jewish Christians.
Paul and Peter stood together at the Jerusalem Council affirming that Gentiles are saved by grace apart from the law.
